notes.title: Office Elevator Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Today we've made some changes/fixes:
- Fixed some objects clipping into each other
- Now achievements appear as soon as you get them instead of having to close the game
- Minor fixes

Thanks so much for the support and STAY PUNX!

notes.title: v1.1 Update - VHS Intensity and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hi there! After collecting feedback we made the following adjustments to Office Elevator:
- The options menu now has a VHS intensity slider, which will help reduce motion sickness for more sensitive people.
- In some rare cases the monster was able to go through a door, that has been fixed.
- The monster can now see you through glass doors.

If you have any other feedback don't hesitate to contact us!

WE ARE PUNX!
